blind_rule: Only after complete echo pass: fresh A/D sentence audit and 20 thoughts per arm with separate private random key. No keys released before actual scores and hashes are committed.
conditions: Original T39 soul, cases, trajectory, same own-seed history, A's prompt/validator/sampler; prefer.choose with away=MindAway. Only first canonical turn draws up to four. On all-refused, original refusal loop has two further calls. Maximum six requests per decision.
measures: Original frozen T39 measures; compare saved A per-day/pooled; report all-call mean, selector draw mean and no-fresh count. Echo <=10.99% is only the machine prerequisite; human truth/voice pending.
no_fresh_rule: No accepted fresh reply among the initial up-to-four draws (note.refused + note.echo == note.n), regardless of later canonical refusal outcome.
seed_rule: Draw 1 is the paired seed. Draws 2..4: SHA256 UTF-8 'T49-D-20261113-v1\0<case id>\0<paired seed>\0<draw ordinal>\0<nonce>'; first 8 bytes big-endian modulo (2**31-1), plus 2**31. Nonce starts zero; increment only to avoid an already assigned seed, in manifest/paired-seed/draw order. UINT32_MAX is excluded. Canonical refusal turns 2/3 retain the paired seed.
seed_separation: Dedicated namespace and high uint32 range; T39/M1/Training3 declared seeds are low fixed integers; reviewed Phase A request_seed returns values below 2147483647. No claim that unrelated historical experiments never used a numeric seed in this range.
shown_rule: Only Earlier today thought excerpts, exactly prefer.shown_thoughts; original T39 scoring still compares all actually visible earlier thoughts.
